title: OpenXR Spatial Containers Bring a Cross-Platform Spatial Windowing API to XR
subtitle: The Khronos® OpenXR™ Working Group has released a new set of extensions that establish an open, cross-platform API for spatial windowing systems. The extensions introduce "spatial containers" to OpenXR, which are system-managed spaces in which applications can display XR content, similar to how traditional applications draw 2D content within windows on a desktop. Spatial containers give developers a standardized way to create applications that can move between immersive experiences and multitasking with the real world or other apps across compatible XR platforms.
